name: Library of Alexandria
text: The Library of Alexandria in Alexandria, Egypt, was one of the largest and most significant libraries of the ancient world. The library was part of a larger research institution called the Mouseion, which was dedicated to the Muses, the nine goddesses of the arts. The idea of the library in Alexandria may have been proposed by Demetrius of Phalerum, an exiled Athenian statesman living in Alexandria, to Ptolemy I Soter, who may have established plans for the library, but the library itself was probably not built until the reign of his son Ptolemy II Philadelphus.

depictions.name: Great Library of Alexandria
depictions.text: Library of Alexandria The (or Great Library of Alexandria) is a wonder in the Civilization games and C-evo. It provides its owner with bonuses related to science, such as automatic discovery of any technology that has been researched by at least two other civilizations. "Great Library" may also refer to the Civilopedia analogue in the Call to Power games. ru:Великая библиотека

depictions.name: Library of Alexandria
depictions.text: The Library of Alexandria, also known as Great Library of Alexandria, was one of the largest and most significant libraries of the ancient world located in Alexandria, Egypt. First built by Ptolemy I Soter and finished under Ptolemy II, it was dedicated to the Muses, the nine goddesses of the arts and daughters of Zeus, and was said to hold anywhere between 40,000 to 400,000 scrolls. It was part of a larger research institution known as the Mouseion of Alexandria.
